svg.title: KAUO source-backed pavement inventory and retained legacy geometry
svg.desc: ALDOT source pavement-section polygons are shown in local ENU. FAA runway centerlines are separate. Candidate OSM taxiway centerlines are green, MEDIUM confidence, and not approved for routing. Approximate legacy nodes and edges are dashed and quarantined.
svg.text: Readiness: DATA_BLOCKED; candidate centerlines are for topology review only, not operational routing
